name: @red-cup-engineering/block-device-io-coordinator
description: A device I/O provider that assays syscall-scale RMN effects and witnesses their FOUR cover transitions without buying shared-ledger consensus.

scripts.check: node --check src/bound-git-profile-wire.js && node --check src/bound-git-profile-auth.js && node --check src/bound-git-profile-store.js && node --check src/bound-git-profile.js && node --check src/bound-git-profile-a2a-executor.js && node --check src/serve-bound-git-profile.js

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: ActivityStreams request carrying a parent typed-RMN task identity and CAIP-10 caller
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: unscoped device, absent RMN parent, missing CAIP-10 party, RMN refusal, non-Git operation, customer-territory write authority, unenforceable device-wide claim, or unavailable host authority

serve-bound-git-profile.returns: one coordinator-signed BoundGitProfileReceipt or BoundGitProfileRefusal RMN part
